caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram illustrates the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref, organized into 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories. The primary categories are represented by three large segments: "Virtual Characters," which is the largest and colored light blue; "Real Characters," colored green; and "Custom Characters," colored pink. These primary categories are further divided into subcategories, with "Virtual Characters" including "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," all shown in varying shades of light blue. "Real Characters" encompasses "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," each displayed in progressively darker shades of green. "Custom Characters" is a single subcategory in pink. The diagram includes a central label for each primary category, with subcategories radiating outward. The percentages for each segment are not explicitly labeled within the diagram, and no legend is present, though the color coding distinguishes the categories and subcategories. The segments are arranged in a circular layout, with the largest segments appearing first in the sequence.
